## Highlights since 0.3.0

- **A redesigned Papers library.** Wide, the library is a sortable table (Title · Authors · Year · Venue · Cited) with filters for papers cited in the manuscript, not cited yet, or with full text, and grouping by year, venue or reading state. Selecting a paper opens an inspector with its authors, abstract and record, a copyable `\cite`, and every place the manuscript cites it as a jump. Narrow, the tools fold into icons and each row shows a status glyph, its venue and how often it is cited.
- **One Add papers sheet.** Paste DOIs, arXiv IDs, links, titles or a whole `.bib`; each line resolves to a card, papers already in the library are skipped, and nothing is written until you choose "Add N papers". The add box says what it will add before you press Enter and shows the import's progress in a row.
- **Find literature.** Each result shows how it ranks (alphaXiv votes or OpenAlex citations) and opens into a preview with the abstract, all authors and the identifier, with Add to Papers and Citation only as named actions.
- **Check references, verdict first.** The report opens with its verdict and what it read, then groups findings by what each asks of you. Review them as a keyboard queue: J/K move, A or ⌘↩ applies, S skips, and finishing one opens the next. A fix shows the reference as printed with the change marked in place; inline `\bibitem` entries name their file and line.
- **Restyled Providers, MCP and Skills settings** in the same card layout as Appearance and Editor & builds.

## Notable fixes

- Adding `arXiv:…` identifiers no longer misses papers already in the library.
- A verified work under a publisher's notice now asks for your review instead of reading as verified.
- The reference check's Select-all checkbox no longer stacks over its label, and updates are no longer badged as successes.
- Paper health chips meet AA contrast.
